info.title: CommonBeacon REST API
info.description: Implemented /api/v1 contract. Same-origin cookie sessions, CSRF on every mutation. Roles include MEMBER, MODERATOR, ADMINISTRATOR. Ordinary conversation writes reject archived boards; reporting/moderation remain available. Text is plain text, trimmed as documented and bounded in UTF-16 units (JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points). All page offsets must fit a signed 32-bit integer. Business failures use ProblemDetail; infrastructure failures can have other response shapes. Health probes /api/health and /healthz are deployment endpoints, outside this contract.

post.summary: Create an export of the signed-in account
post.description: Requires an ACTIVE account, CSRF, a UUID Idempotency-Key and a PERSONAL_EXPORT recent-authentication grant. The authenticated requester is the only subject, including for administrators. Unknown fields, subject IDs and company options are rejected. Includes only own profile, own authored content (including hidden text), own report receipts and minimal board/opaque reference context; excludes other authors and moderation decisions. Matching retries return the original personal job without consuming another grant. Storage must be enabled. Poll /api/v1/account/data/jobs and obtain a fresh DOWNLOAD grant/ticket when READY. Personal portability cannot restore a company community. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

put.summary: Stream an archive into private quarantine
put.description: Requester-only UPLOADING import, ACTIVE ADMINISTRATOR and CSRF required. Raw application/zip only, maximum actual body 64 MiB including chunked bodies. No multipart, filename, path or URL. Ten-minute deadline and 30-second idle timeout. Successful complete upload stores SHA-256 and moves to UPLOADED; a worker automatically inspects it. Interrupted uploads return to UPLOADING and may restart in full; cancelled/expired jobs require new initiation. Another active upload/worker or retry after completion returns 409. Proxy failures may have non-ProblemDetail bodies. No domain data is written.

Rechecks target generation and state, mapping/staging fingerprints and source metadata; changed inputs mark the review stale. Reports no raw source values. READY_TO_COMMIT means validation and bootstrap-target checks passed, not permission to activate. A fresh eligible review exposes activationAvailable=true; confirmation still requires the separate protected endpoint.

post.description: Requester-only ACTIVE administrator with unchanged authorization revision, CSRF and single-use IMPORT_COMMIT password grant. Binds the reviewed version, digests, target generation and every warning. Returns 202 COMMITTING before worker activation; cancellation is then refused. Same key and confirmation body replays authoritative state without consuming another grant, including after completion. The worker rechecks inputs under an exclusive migration gate and commits live rows, provenance and completion together within 30 seconds. Gate conflicts return 409 IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS. At most 40,000 rows and 16 MiB staged JSON; populated targets cannot activate.
